A Stunning Setting Undone by a Tourist-Driven Experience
Nov 2025 • Friends
Y Thao Garden has an undeniably captivating setting. Tucked within the ancient walled Hue Imperial City and housed inside a former estate, the restaurant instantly evokes the atmosphere of imperial-era dining. The grand dining room is designed to replicate the elegance of an imperial residence, and the menu is built around that theme.

Unfortunately, that’s where the authenticity begins to fade.

While the dishes offer an introductory glimpse into Hue’s cuisine, the overall execution feels more like a tourist checklist than a true cultural experience. The food is fine, but lacks the depth and care you’d expect from a place promising an imperial dining journey.

Service mirrors this sentiment—indifferent, rushed, and clearly structured around turning over tour groups throughout the day. It removes any sense of ceremony or warmth that could have elevated the meal.

Y Thao Garden is also one of the more expensive dining options in Hue. I’m more than willing to pay for a thoughtfully crafted experience, especially in such a historic setting, but the service and execution simply didn’t meet the promise.

Beautiful to look at, but ultimately a miss if you're seeking genuine hospitality and a memorable culinary experience. I would've skipped this stop if I had a do over.

Thank you very much for sharing your experience. 

At Y Thao Garden, we always strive to preserve the elegance of Hue cuisine, with careful attention to every dish and the ambiance, in order to recreate the authentic flavors and distinctive character of traditional Hue cuisine. For regular meals, guests can enjoy the beauty of Hue’s culinary tradition through refined presentation and authentic flavors.

However, the “imperial culinary experience” that many visitors expect is a higher-level journey. It goes beyond simply tasting the food, encompassing special elements such as the setting, ceremonial rituals, traditional music, and a style of service that reflects the royal spirit. To deliver this experience properly, we require thorough preparation—from the menu and décor to the service style. Therefore, such special requests usually need to be arranged in advance, so we have sufficient time to organize and ensure the experience is complete.

Over the years, Y Thao Garden has successfully hosted many customized imperial dining programs for guests who wished to explore Hue’s royal culinary culture in greater depth. These experiences are held in private settings, offering a truly elevated and worthy culinary journey.

We sincerely look forward to the opportunity to welcome you to a full, refined, and memorable imperial dining experience. 

Respectfully.

Fantastic place!
Oct 2025 • Couples
Recommended by our local guide, we came for dinner and never advice was fairer! High-end restaurant, in an old house surrounded by a charming garden. You eat in a refined and romantic environment lulled by pleasant music. Wide choice of dishes, although I recommend choosing the tasting menus (7 different proposals) whose courses can be shared and exchanged among diners to expand the tasting of food. The dishes are elegantly and artistically composed and explained by the waiter. Although I had already tasted many dishes elsewhere, I must say that here they are more refined, delicate and well cooked with high quality raw materials. A little 'poor choice of drinks that does not include a wine list, excellent and reserved of course the Service. A place not only for the body but also for the spirit: fantastic evening.
